🇰🇿 🚨 KAZAKHSTAN: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS TO SELL ~99K CUSTOMER RECORDS FROM ONLINE MARKETPLACE AYAN MARKET

A threat actor on an underground forum is offering what it says is the customer database of Ayan Market, a Kazakh online marketplace.

The post claims:
* 98,921 unique customers and 74,359 addresses
* Phone numbers (93.6% of records) and dates of birth (83.6%)
* First, last and middle names, emails and gender
* Loyalty-customer flags and full delivery addresses (city, street, house, apartment, floor)

A sample was offered, and price is available on request.

Phone numbers linked to names, birth dates and home addresses are a ready-made kit for SMS phishing and delivery scams aimed at Ayan Market shoppers. The detailed field percentages suggest the actor has the dataset in hand. Ayan Market has not confirmed an incident. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.title: STORY | Delhi's AQI enters 'very poor' category for first time this season at 312 Delhi's air quality slipped into the 'very poor' category for the fi...
item.description:
STORY | Delhi's AQI enters 'very poor' category for first time this season at 312

Delhi's air quality slipped into the 'very poor' category for the first time this season on Monday, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) recording 312 at 9 am, while the minimum temperature at the Safdarjung weather station settled at 16.4 degrees Celsius, 1.1 notches above normal.

The minimum temperatures at other weather stations were recorded at 16.4 degrees Celsius at Palam, 16.8 degrees at Lodhi Road, 17.2 degrees at the Ridge and 16.7 degrees at Ayanagar, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD).

No rainfall was recorded at any of the five weather stations during the 24 hours ending at 8.30 am on Monday.

The AQI reading of 312 is the morning reading and not the day's average, which will be available at 4 pm, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

According to the CPCB, an AQI between zero and 50 is considered 'good', 51 and 100 'satisfactory', 101 and 200 'moderate', 201 and 300 'poor', 301 and 400 'very poor', and 401 and 500 'severe'.

Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) Stage 2 is applied in Delhi when the Air Quality Index (AQI) enters the "Very Poor" category, ranging between 301 and 400.

The Sub-Committee for Operationalisation of the GRAP, i.e., the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM), decides to invoke Stage 2 based on dynamic air quality and meteorological forecasts, include strict measures to curb air pollution.

item.description:
STORY | Delhi pollution curbs: Fines worth Rs 68 lakh imposed, 1,539 vehicles turned back at border on day 1

Delhi authorities imposed penalties and environmental compensation totalling Rs 68.4 lakh on the first day of the Winter Action Plan, with nearly 15,000 vehicles checked, 1,539 turned back at border points and 566 challans issued for violations of Pollution Under Control Certificate (PUCC) norms.

According to official data available till 5 pm on Sunday, the total amount comprised Rs 56.6 lakh in penalties for PUCC violations, Rs 2 lakh in fines for violations of border entry restrictions and Rs 9.8 lakh in environmental compensation for construction and demolition-related violations.

Under the enforcement of the ban on non-Delhi pre-BS-VI vehicles, 14,930 vehicles were checked by the Delhi Traffic Police and the Transport Department, and about 10.31 per cent of them were turned back.

Up to 127 challans were issued, and 62 vehicles were impounded as well, with Delhi Traffic Police's enforcement teams imposing fines amounting to Rs 2 lakh.

Among the vehicles turned back, 140 were light motor vehicles (LMVs), 54 light commercial vehicles (LCVs), 95 heavy goods vehicles (MGVs/HGVs) and 34 buses.

🇮🇩 🚨 INDONESIA: THREAT ACTOR LEAKS 6.58M INTERNAL EVENT LOGS FROM SURVEILLANCE AI FIRM NODEFLUX

A threat actor has posted a free download on an underground forum that it says contains internal event logs from Nodeflux, a Jakarta-based computer-vision company known for facial-recognition and surveillance systems.

The post claims:
* About 6.58 million internal event records (1.7GB uncompressed JSON Lines, 136MB compressed)
* Access keys and secret keys
* Emails, account IDs and user data such as login details, IP addresses, payment methods and timestamps
* A breach date of Oct 21, 2026, with "no ransom, just leak" framing

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Leaked access and secret keys are the urgent part: if still valid, they could open Nodeflux systems, and possibly customer deployments of its facial-recognition platform, to further intrusion. Any key in the logs should be treated as compromised and rotated. Nodeflux has not confirmed an incident. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

An ICCI-UNEP report, about the impacts of the temporary breach of the 1.5-degree warming threshold in the near future on earth's ice sheets and glaciers, indicates that the crisis is closer to home and not confined to remote regions, a lead author of the report said on Monday.

In an interview with PTI Videos, James Kirkham, Chief Scientist at the International Cryosphere Climate Initiative (ICCI) and coordinating lead author of the report, said that further increases in temperature would significantly intensify many impacts and could lock in several of the most severe ones.

A threat actor on an underground forum has posted a "Guatemala Attack DB" listing, claiming an attack on Guatemalan websites exposed databases from two public institutions.

The post claims:
* Data from DIGECAM, Guatemala's directorate for arms and ammunition control
* Data from USAC (Universidad de San Carlos de Guatemala), the country's national public university
* Personal records and other sensitive data, per the listing

No record counts, field lists or sample rows were visible in the captured post.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
A DIGECAM dataset could expose firearm licence and owner records, which carry physical-security risk well beyond typical identity fraud. The posting account is about one month old and frames the post as a hacktivist-style "Guatemala has fallen" attack, so the data may be partial or recycled. Neither institution has confirmed an incident. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.title: 🤖 ATTACKERS POSE AS CHATGPT, CLAUDE AND OTHER AI BOTS TO HUNT FOR CREDENTIALS Cequence research published Oct 28 tracks a single actor that rotated...
item.description:
🤖 ATTACKERS POSE AS CHATGPT, CLAUDE AND OTHER AI BOTS TO HUNT FOR CREDENTIALS

Cequence research published Oct 28 tracks a single actor that rotated through about 32 fake AI bot identities, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Perplexity crawlers and assistants, while scanning for secrets.

• It skipped web pages and requested ~90 secret-holding paths: .env files, cloud credential files, private SSH keys, server environment data
• Short bursts of 50–190 requests in ~8 seconds per address, active from at least late September through late October
• 300+ cloud IPs in one day and nearly 400 in a week, so IP blocklists went stale within days
• On one October day it reached 48% of Cequence-protected orgs that saw any AI bot traffic; finance, retail, telecom, energy and software were hit

Cequence says nearly all requests were blocked or failed.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
A bot's user-agent proves nothing. Verify AI agents via signed requests or published IP ranges, and flag any "AI assistant" asking for config or credential files. Findings are vendor telemetry from its own customers; no victims are named and no confirmed credential theft is reported.

https://www.cequence.ai/blog/ai-agent-impersonation

item.title: PALM BEACH LEARJET CRASH: WHAT WE KNOW SO FAR Aircraft: Learjet 60, registration N722BD. Flight: Departed Austin, Texas, bound for North Eleuthera, Ba...
item.description:
PALM BEACH LEARJET CRASH: WHAT WE KNOW SO FAR

Aircraft: Learjet 60, registration N722BD.

Flight: Departed Austin, Texas, bound for North Eleuthera, Bahamas.

Passengers: FAA reports 9 people on board.

Altitude: Aircraft reached approximately 41,000 feet before descending.

Final moments: Flight data indicates a steep right turn and a descent exceeding 32,000 feet per minute.

Last signal: Recorded at approximately 8,750 feet.

Crash site: Greenacres, Palm Beach County, Florida, in a residential neighborhood.

Impact: Aircraft reportedly disintegrated, leaving a large fire and crater.

Location: Approximately 7 to 8 miles west of Mar-a-Lago.

Weather: Thunderstorms were reported in the area.

Operator: Reportedly operated by Aurora Aviation under FAA Part 135 charter regulations.

Casualties: Official fatality figures and possible casualties on the ground have not been confirmed.

Investigation: NTSB is leading the investigation with FAA assistance.

Cause of crash remains unknown.

item.title: IRGC CLAIMS 2 OIL TANKERS STRUCK NAVAL MINES IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ The IRGC Navy claims 2 oil tankers, including a supertanker reportedly still burning,...
item.description:
IRGC CLAIMS 2 OIL TANKERS STRUCK NAVAL MINES IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ

The IRGC Navy claims 2 oil tankers, including a supertanker reportedly still burning, struck “naval mines” while attempting to pass through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz.

According to the IRGC, both vessels had disabled their navigation and identification systems and were attempting to transit the strait with U.S. military support.

CAUTION: These claims remain unverified. The IRGC has previously attributed vessel strikes to naval mines when evidence pointed to drones or anti-ship missiles. Other reported attacks were never independently confirmed.

So far, we are aware of only 1 reported incident involving a vessel.

The tug and supply vessel Selat Storm (IMO 9266657) was reportedly struck by an unidentified projectile.

There is currently no independent confirmation that 2 oil tankers struck naval mines, as the IRGC claims.

item.description:
🇲🇽 🚨 MEXICO: HACKERS CLAIM LEAK OF GUERRERO STATE GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEE DATA FROM SICECO PLATFORM

A threat actor group on a dark web forum claims to have leaked user and employee data from SICECO, a Guerrero state platform for the control and registration of state government projects and actions.

According to the post, the data covers users and workers at 144 agencies, including:
* Guerrero Attorney General's Office
* Secretariat of Public Security
* Administrative Justice Tribunal and Superior Court of Justice
* Acapulco municipal water commission and a state lodging-tax trust

Fields listed: agency, username, full name, phone, email and access level.

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
This is a separate claim from the Guerrero State Ministry of Education (SEG) leak the same group posted in mid-October, and points to repeated targeting of Guerrero state systems. Staff names, phones and emails at prosecutors, police and courts are useful for targeted phishing and intimidation. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of Guerrero state systems.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Mexico #Guerrero #Government #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence
